dev.headline: I build *intelligent* software — AI pipelines, physics-based simulations and the hardware that ties them together.
dev.intro:
I'm Fuzail Ahmed, a final-year Computer Science student at Bahria University with a background in applied AI, software engineering and real-time 3D.

I lead development on AXIS, a physics-based surgical simulation built in C++ and Unreal Engine 5 that gives real-time feedback on every operational action. I've also built a production-grade RAG pipeline that translates Gen-Z slang into standard English, a deep learning pneumonia detection system reaching 90–95% accuracy, and hardware projects from custom PCBs to ESP32 firmware — bridging cutting-edge 3D graphics with cloud-native AI.

projects.title: AXIS
projects.summary: Anatomy Exploration and Interactive System — a physics-based surgical simulation that responds in real time to every operational action.
projects.body:
Final-year project · Lead Developer and Programmer.

Engineered a high-fidelity, physics-based medical simulation application designed for immersive surgical procedure practice. Developed the core simulation mechanics and interactive 3D environments in C++ and Unreal Engine 5, and programmed real-time feedback loops that analyse and respond to precise operational actions during simulated procedures — delivering realistic physical feedback rather than static asset rotation.

projects.title: Gen-Z Slang Translator
projects.summary: A production-grade RAG system that translates Gen-Z slang into standard English.
projects.body:
AI Pipeline & Backend Developer.

Built and deployed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation translation system with a high-performance Python + FastAPI backend to handle translation queries. Structured, curated and processed a custom NLP dataset of 1,000+ entries for targeted model training.

projects.title: Pneumonia Detection AI
projects.summary: Deep learning computer-vision pipeline that detects pneumonia in chest radiographs with 90–95% accuracy.
projects.body:
AI Engineer & Developer.

Designed and trained a robust computer vision pipeline optimised for medical imaging analysis, implementing deep learning classification models to identify anomalies in radiographic data. Achieved and verified a 90–95% diagnostic accuracy rate during testing.

projects.title: Ambient Lighting Kit
projects.summary: A commercial-grade ambient lighting kit for PC monitors, screen-synced in real time through SignalRGB (in development).
projects.body:
Founder · Hardware & Firmware Developer.

Engineered the kit from the ground up, bridging physical electronics with desktop software. Programmed custom firmware and device configuration for ESP32-S3 microcontrollers, designed custom PCB layouts under strict power constraints, and integrated the hardware with SignalRGB for real-time screen syncing.

projects.title: Smart Traffic Light System
projects.summary: Wireless, motion-aware traffic management that adapts signal timings to real-time vehicle and pedestrian presence.
projects.body:
Hardware & Embedded Systems Developer.

Programmed low-latency embedded firmware that processes motion-sensor input and coordinates wireless communication between intersection nodes. Developed adaptive scheduling algorithms to cut congestion and clear gridlocks, and designed the hardware: power distribution, sensor calibration and durable prototype enclosures.

about.title: 3D Artist, AI Engineer & Software / Game Developer
about.summary:
I'm a 3D modeler, environment designer and CGI specialist with a strong computer science foundation. I build high-fidelity visual assets, interactive simulations and intelligent software pipelines — from commercial-grade 3D product designs, precise texturing and cinematic lighting for freelance clients and PEAK Company, to end-to-end CGI productions where I design and animate 3D garments in Clo3D and Blender, composite them into live footage, and finish them with motion graphics in After Effects and sound design in Premiere Pro.

On the technical side I work in applied AI and software engineering: I lead development of AXIS, a physics-based surgical simulation with real-time feedback; built a production-ready RAG pipeline that translates Gen-Z slang into standard English; and trained a deep learning pneumonia detection system that reaches 90–95% accuracy. I'm completing my Bachelor's in Computer Science, bridging cutting-edge 3D graphics pipelines and cloud-native AI.
